_comment: Subject alias map for prospective canonicalization (spine step 5, Option 2).
_usage: Keys are normalized alias forms (already trimmed, lowercased, whitespace-collapsed). Values are the canonical subject strings (also normalized). Canonicalization order: normalize(trim+lowercase+collapse) first, then alias-map lookup on the normalized form. Add entries here to redirect variant subject spellings to their canonical form.
_example: "my project main" → "my-project main" (if dashes are preferred in the canonical name)
